caption: The drawing depicts an architectural detail featuring a stylized floral ornament positioned at the intersection of two arching elements. The arches are depicted in shades of light and reddish-brown, with visible crack lines suggesting an aged or weathered stone surface. At their intersection, there is a vertically oriented floral motif consisting of a central lattice-patterned element outlined in gold and filled with light blue, with gold accents highlighting the edges. This motif is flanked by two smaller, rounded floral shapes, also in light blue and gold, with delicate gold stems. Above the central lattice element is a larger, abstract flower shape in the same blue and gold hues. At the base of the motif is a round, gold-colored element. The background is a light beige, providing contrast to the colored and textured features. The artist’s name, "W. Kieckhoefel," is inscribed at the bottom right corner.
title: Ceiling Decorations
